Hi Nina! I have some notes from the design review in my handover file. For TEXTKIT-105: Foreign-key columns with more than one word where the last word is 'id' should have that last word dropped (e.g., 'author_id' -> 'Author', 'parentPostId' -> 'Parent post'). A lone 'id' becomes 'ID', and 'id' in any other position is kept (e.g., 'id_card' -> 'ID card'). I hope that helps!
